benchmarks: MEM-INV-Bench (own; 12 domains x 5 consequential tool types, cross-defense x cross-attack x cross-model over 8 frontier models across 6 vendors)
fallos_mitigaciones: Memory poisoning via 3 laundering channels: self-summarization (L-a), trusted-tool echo (L-b), manufactured corroboration (L-c) each erase an item's untrusted origin through a behavior-preserving transformation, defeating content- and lineage-based defenses (up to 68% laundering ASR). Mitigated via TMA-NM: non-malleable origin-bound authority (write-time binding M1 + non-malleable propagation M2 closing L-a/L-b) + Sybil-resistant corroboration-gated elevation (M3, >=2 independent trusted principals, closing L-c) + tamper-evident verdict log (M4). Table1: TMA-NM reaches 0% ASR on direct attack AND laundering at 100% legit-utility (vs baselines: trust_score/capability_ifc 68% laundered, capability_ifc additionally 84% direct-ASR, lineage 47% laundered).
cita: Louck (2026). Securing LLM-Agent Long-Term Memory Against Poisoning: Non-Malleable, Origin-Bound Authority with Machine-Checked Guarantees.
notes: SII threat model: memory item=(content,origin,scope,t_write,act_class), origin assigned by the trusted monitor from the WRITE CHANNEL (user/trusted-tool/agent-self-write/untrusted-ingestion), never from content -> mem_tipos=NA (paper is content-type-agnostic; contributes a FORMAL AUTHORITY/IFC mechanism, not a memory-type taxonomy), trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA (origin-labeling is channel-determined, not LLM-discretionary). SIII M1 write-time origin binding = WRITE; M3 Sybil-resistant corroboration-gated ELEVATION raises an existing item's authority label via >=2 independent trusted principals or fresh user-auth -> ACTUALIZACION. M4 append-only tamper-evident hash-chain verdict log -> representacion=DOCS-ARCHIVOS (structured tuple store + log, no vector/graph index specified); the retrieval mechanism itself is left unspecified/agnostic in the pipeline write->retrieve->act -> retrieval=NA. SIV formal TLA+ model + machine-checked theorems T1(malleable-gate insufficiency)/T2(write-time-binding necessity)/T3(non-malleable-authority sufficiency, 3270 reachable states) -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI (this IS the paper's core contribution: origin/provenance-bound authority). SII explicitly excludes 'cross-agent shared memory' as OUT OF SCOPE ('is out of scope and is the province of agent-communication-protocol security') -> multiagente=NO. SV MEM-INV-Bench: 12 domains x 5 consequential tool types x 5 defense classes (none/trust_score/lineage/capability_ifc/TMA-NM) x 8 frontier models (6 vendors) x {direct,L-a,L-b,L-c} + legit-utility/uncorr-auto controls. Table1 pooled results confirm baselines fail exactly where the separation theorem predicts -> evidencia_tipo=BENCHMARK-E2E, mide_lectura=SI/RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO (legit-utility=100% control rules out block-everything tautology, directly measuring preserved read/act utility). Deployability: TMA-NM act-gate = 1.3us/decision vs ~2000ms for a content-detection judge call (~6 orders of magnitude cheaper); 'all runs report cost' -> COSTO/MEDICION-COSTO. Cross-model trigger-style study + 'the ablation isolates each mechanism' (SVI) -> evidencia_tipo also ABLATION. All TMA-NM-vs-baseline gaps significant at p<5e-5 (20,000-iteration permutation test). alcance: threat model explicitly 'store untrusted content in one session that later steers... in a future session' / 'weeks later, in an unrelated session' -> PROYECTO (persists across many sessions). F differs from F_screening (SEGURIDAD) by adding FIDELIDAD, RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO and COSTO per above anchors.

benchmarks: own P1 factorial dataset from prior work (Leong 2026): 2,520 labeled DTA runs (9 open-source models x 7 defense conditions x 40 runs); frontier probes GPT-4.1 (N=20 pre-populated + 405/560 expanded evaluation)
fallos_mitigaciones: Memory-channel poisoning (delayed-trigger attack, DTA): a malicious routing rule is stored in persistent memory in an early session and retrieved+executed (email exfiltration) in a later trigger session. Mitigation is a forensic TRAJECTORY DETECTOR (tool-call logs only, no memory-content access) exploiting the mechanistically-forced recall_before_send invariant: Recall=0.984-1.000/AUC=0.990 under 6/7 defense conditions; the ONE structural blind spot is the Memory-Sandbox condition (recall_fact tool removed), where an implicit-bypass attack variant (qwq:32b, goal-directed RAG fallback) evades detection entirely (all 31 FN). Evasion boundary: prompt-inline attacks (no memory write) score near the decision boundary (mean 0.541, Recall=0.35 only), explicitly enabling attack-vector attribution rather than full mitigation.
cita: Leong (2026). Forensic Trajectory Signatures for Agent Memory Poisoning Detection.
notes: S2.1-2.2 threat model: attacker injects a routing-rule key-value fact via RAG into persistent memory (memory.save_fact/recall_fact/list_all_facts tool API); exfiltration in a LATER trigger session S4 requires memory.recall_fact(key) before email.send_email -> underlying memory operations = WRITE(save_fact) + GREP-ARCHIVOS retrieval (exact key lookup by name, not ranked/embedding search); representacion=DOCS-ARCHIVOS (key-value fact store). mem_tipos=NA: the paper's OWN contribution is a forensic TRAJECTORY classifier over tool-call logs (never memory contents/weights/activations/user messages, S2.1 'Detection constraint'), not a memory-content taxonomy. S2.2 dataset: 2,520 labeled DTA runs from prior work's P1 factorial (9 open-source models x 7 defense conditions x 40 runs; 1,919 attack-success/601 non-exfiltration). Table1: 19-feature Random Forest AUC=0.9904 (BCa 95%CI[0.987,0.993], N=10000 resamples), Recall=0.9838; single-rule baseline (recall_before_send alone) already AUC=0.9563 -> mechanistically forced by the attack's information-retrieval dependency (S3.3). Table6 feature-group ablation: removing ALL 9 recall-related features (half the feature set) leaves AUC UNCHANGED at 0.9904 -> overdetermined signature across independent channels -> evidencia_tipo=ABLATION. Table4 cross-model hold-out (9 models, 7B-120B): AUC=1.000 on 6/9 models; 3 mechanistically-explained exceptions (qwq:32b implicit RAG-fallback bypass; qwen2.5:14b distributional inversion from benign verification recalls; qwen3.5:122b sleeper/Prompt-Hardening label ambiguity). Table5: ALL 31 false negatives concentrate in the Memory-Sandbox defense condition. S3.7 frontier validation (GPT-4.1, N=20, zero-shot) confirms Recall=1.000, model-agnostic; S3.8 evasion boundary: prompt-inline attacks (no memory write) produce a distinct low-score trajectory -> evidencia_tipo also BENCHMARK-E2E. This is a DETECTION/forensic-audit paper: it does not measure retrieval PRECISION/utility for task performance, only uses retrieval EVENTS as forensic classification features -> mide_lectura=NO. No provenance/staleness verification proposed -> fidelidad_procedencia=NO. Single-agent tool-call-log analysis, no cross-agent memory sharing -> multiagente=NO. Attacker-planted routing-rule value persists as raw stored CONTENT from injection session through the later trigger session -> handoff=CONTENIDO. alcance=SESION (attack persists dormant from injection session to a later trigger session within one deployment).

benchmarks: own multi-domain evaluation (EHR, ReAct-QA, RAP shopping) x 3 LLM models x 50 trials; 326 benign agent traces for false-positive-rate check; no established external benchmark
fallos_mitigaciones: FARMA reasoning-trace-forgery attack: poisons what the agent thinks it ALREADY REASONED/DID (not factual knowledge) via evasive-language seed injection + self-referential amplification, up to 100% ASR baseline, defeats keyword filter and A-MemGuard consensus defense. Mitigated by SENTINEL 5-layer defense-in-depth pipeline (keyword/provenance/taint-threshold/pattern-risk prefilters + Reasoning Guard structural analysis with 5 weighted forgery signals), reducing ASR to as low as 0% with ZERO false positives across 326 benign traces; explicit finding that the Reasoning Guard is the primary load-bearing component.
cita: Karamchandani et al. (2026). Your Agent's Memories Are Not Its Own: Forged Reasoning Attacks on LLM Agent Memory and Defenses.
notes: S2.B system model: general MEMORY STORE (facts/experiences) vs distinct REASONING STORE (decision logs, intermediate rationales, self-reflections) -> reasoning traces are records of PRIOR AGENT DECISIONS -> mem_tipos=EPISODICA. S2.B 'agent issues a query... retrieves top-k most relevant entries (typically via dense vector similarity)' -> representacion=VECTOR, retrieval=EMBEDDINGS. Algorithm1 AddReasoningTrace/AddMemory = WRITE; S4 SENTINEL applies BOTH lightweight prefilters AND the Reasoning Guard structural check SYNCHRONOUSLY 'on the memory-write path' before committing an entry to storage -> ADMISION, trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA (deterministic per-write gate) alongside the agent's own reasoning-trace writes being an LLM-driven logging decision -> trigger=DISCRECIONAL-LLM;EVENTO-DETERMINISTA. S3 FARMA 2-phase attack: Phase1 seed injection (templated forged decision-log entries, evasive vocabulary + structural similarity, source=AGENT/trust=VERIFIED metadata-spoofed) + Phase2 amplification (cites growing prior-run counts -> defeats consensus-deviation defenses like A-MemGuard by making forged entries the CONSENSUS, and raises top-k retrieval-surfacing probability). S4 SENTINEL 5 layers: L1 keyword filter, L2 provenance/IFC labeling (taint 0.0 trusted/0.4 external/1.0 unknown), L3 taint-threshold, L4 pattern/risk screening, L5 Reasoning Guard (5 weighted forgery signals incl. s1 provenance-anomaly) -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI. Abstract/S1: FARMA up to 100% ASR baseline across 3 domains x 3 models x 50 trials, defeats keyword-filter+A-MemGuard; SENTINEL reduces ASR to as low as 0% with ZERO false positives across 326 benign traces; explicit ablation-style finding that 'Reasoning Guard is the primary load-bearing component... lightweight outer layers contribute defense in depth' -> evidencia_tipo=ABLATION;BENCHMARK-E2E. Threat model (S2.C) explicitly lists 'a shared memory store in a multi-user or multi-agent environment' as an attack vector, and Intro cites OWASP ASI06: 'especially in multi-agent frameworks where shared memory stores turn one agent's writes into another agent's reads' -> multiagente=SI. Reasoning traces are literally DECISION-LOG/progress-state content ('asserting certain actions have already been completed and can be skipped') -> plan_estado=SI (this IS the attack surface). No retrieval-precision/utility metric reported (only write-admission ASR/FPR) -> mide_lectura=NO. F differs from F_screening (SEGURIDAD) by adding FIDELIDAD and MULTIAGENTE per above anchors.

benchmarks: MIMIC-III (EHRAgent records source), Webshop (RAP framework records source); own MEXTRA attack prompts, no external privacy-extraction benchmark
fallos_mitigaciones: MEXTRA memory-extraction attack (fallo): black-box attacking-prompt design (locator+aligner) + automated diverse-prompt generation extracts private past user queries stored in agent memory (Extracted-Number up to 50/30 attacks on EHRAgent, 26/30 on RAP; Complete-Extracted-Rate 0.83/0.87). No mitigation is proposed or evaluated in this paper; the authors note only 'the urgent need for effective memory safeguards' as future work.
cita: Wang et al. (2025). Unveiling Privacy Risks in LLM Agent Memory.
notes: S2.1 memory module M stores m records (qi,si) = past user-query/agent-solution pairs used as in-context demonstrations -> mem_tipos=EPISODICA. S2.1 retrieval: similarity scoring f(q,qi) configurable between edit-distance (text-based) and cosine-similarity-over-SBERT-embeddings (MiniLM/MPNet/RoBERTa) -> representacion=HIBRIDA, retrieval=RANKING;EMBEDDINGS (top-k ranked retrieval, embedding variant studied). S2.1 'If the solution is executed successfully, the new query-solution pair will be evaluated and then selectively added to the memory for reflection' -> operaciones=WRITE;ADMISION, trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA (write gated on successful execution, not LLM-discretionary). S4.1 2 real agents: EHRAgent (code agent, MIMIC-III records, edit-distance top-4) + RAP/Webshop (cosine-similarity top-3, SBERT/MiniLM embeddings). Table1 (n=30 prompts, m=200): MEXTRA extracts EN=50/EHRAgent, EN=26/RAP (CER=0.83/0.87) vs 3 ablated baselines (w/o-aligner/w/o-req/w/o-demos) all substantially weaker -> evidencia_tipo=ABLATION. S5 RQ2 systematically sweeps 5 memory-module configuration axes (scoring function edit-vs-cosine, embedding model, retrieval depth k=1-5, memory size m=50-500, LLM backbone) and measures their effect on Extracted-Number/Retrieved-Number/Extracted-Efficiency (Table2/Fig2/Fig3/Table3): e.g. edit-distance consistently more vulnerable than cosine-similarity across all memory sizes -> this IS a deep quantitative study of the RETRIEVAL mechanism's behavior -> mide_lectura=SI/RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO. No defense/mitigation is proposed or evaluated in this paper -> fallos_mitigaciones anchor. No provenance/staleness discussion -> fidelidad_procedencia=NO. Single-agent memory, no cross-agent sharing -> multiagente=NO. Memory persists across many past interactions up to size 500 (long-term store) -> alcance=PROYECTO. F differs from F_screening (SEGURIDAD) by adding RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO per S5 retrieval-configuration-sweep anchor.

benchmarks: own 3 illustrative domains (multi-agent software-dev 4-agent pipeline / healthcare AI 3-agent HIPAA workflow / multi-modal 4-agent image-analysis); NOTE: reported numbers are explicitly PROJECTED estimates from distributed-systems literature (S5.2), not measurements on an implemented SAMEP system
fallos_mitigaciones: Paper's S7 'Limitations' lists 4 general architectural drawbacks rather than a poisoning/staleness attack-defense pair: ongoing storage-infrastructure cost, privacy concerns from encrypted sharing, added protocol complexity hindering adoption, and centralized-memory single-point-of-dependency. No adversarial attack or memory-poisoning threat model is defined or mitigated; security claims are limited to access-control/encryption/audit design, evaluated only via the projected (not measured) 100% compliance / zero-unauthorized-access figures.
cita: Masoor (2025). SAMEP: A Secure Agent Memory Exchange Protocol for Persistent Context Sharing in Multi-Agent AI Systems.
notes: S3.2 Core Memory API: Store/Retrieve/Search/Update/Delete -> operaciones=WRITE;ADMISION(access-control validation on every op)/OLVIDO(Delete + 'automatic lifecycle management and garbage collection' + 'automatic retention policies')/ACTUALIZACION(Update modifies context metadata). S4.2 multi-backend storage: PostgreSQL/JSONB (structured) + Pinecone (vector) + Redis (cache) -> representacion=HIBRIDA. S3.4 Theorem1 dense-embedding cosine-similarity semantic search -> retrieval=EMBEDDINGS;RANKING (Top-1 Accuracy metric implies ranking). S3.3 hierarchical access-control (public/private/namespace/acl/encrypted, Def.1) scoped by 'namespace' (organizational/team boundary) for regulated-industry (HIPAA) deployment -> alcance=ORGANIZACION. S3.2 audit-trail field on every memory entry (timestamp/action/agent/success) + 'complete audit trail generation' + 'validated HIPAA compliance' -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI. Multi-agent pipelines throughout (4-agent software-dev, 3-agent healthcare, 4-agent multi-modal) -> multiagente=SI. CRITICAL INTEGRITY FLAG (S5.2, verbatim): 'Due to significant variability in system environments, we present PROJECTED performance results based on averaged benchmarks from distributed systems literature' -- Table1/S5.3's 73% redundant-computation reduction, 89% context-relevance improvement, 309% Top-1-accuracy improvement, throughput/latency numbers are NOT measurements on an implemented SAMEP system, they are ESTIMATES/projections. Per rule2 (demos/projections graded like the calibration bar) -> evidencia_tipo=CUALITATIVA only (NOT BENCHMARK-E2E/MEDICION-COSTO despite Table-formatted numbers). Correspondingly mide_lectura=NO (no ACTUAL read-quality measurement occurred) and F DROPS RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO from F_screening; F ADDS FIDELIDAD (audit-trail/HIPAA provenance mechanism). RECONSIDERAR: the entire empirical section is admittedly speculative/projected rather than an evaluation of an actually-built system (no real experiments on SAMEP itself are reported anywhere in the paper) -- flagged for human review of inclusion; the paper's generic 'context data' storage is content-type-agnostic -> mem_tipos=NA.

benchmarks: ReAct-StrategyQA + EHRAgent (AgentPoison direct-poisoning config, Chen et al. 2024), MMLU (MINJA indirect-injection config, Dong et al. 2025), MISINFOTASK (multi-agent scalability, Li et al. 2025)
fallos_mitigaciones: Memory poisoning (direct AgentPoison-style + indirect MINJA-style self-reinforcing error cycles); existing defenses (LLM Auditor/Distil Classifier/PPL filter) fail because they audit memory entries in ISOLATION (ASB cited: 66% missed poisoned entries) and miss context-dependent harm. A-MemGuard mitigates via consensus-based validation (cross-memory reasoning-path divergence detection) + dual-memory lesson structure (breaks self-reinforcing error cycles). Table1: ASR-r reduced from 100.0 to as low as 2.13 (EHRAgent, GPT-4o-mini+DPR), consistently >95% average ASR reduction, while maintaining the highest benign accuracy vs all baselines.
cita: Wei et al. (2025). A-MemGuard: A Proactive Defense Framework for LLM-Based Agent Memory.
notes: S3.1 primary memory M={m1..mN} is generic ('prior interaction or piece of knowledge'; Related-Work S2 cites episodic/semantic/procedural as PRIOR taxonomy) but A-MemGuard's OWN NOVEL memory-type contribution is the LESSON memory Mles, storing DISTILLED structured reasoning paths (semantic entity-relation trajectories, Eq.6) as corrective precedent consulted before future actions -> mem_tipos=PROCEDIMENTAL (learned corrective policy-like knowledge). S5.1 retrieval architectures DPR/REALM (dense embedding retrieval) -> representacion=VECTOR, retrieval=EMBEDDINGS;RANKING (top-K=4). S4.1 consensus-validation module V(qt,Mr)->Mval filters retrieved memories BEFORE they inform the agent's policy (Eq.3/8) -> operaciones=ADMISION; S4.2 'structured path... becomes the negative lesson... archived in lesson memory' (Eq.9) is a distillation/CONSOLIDACION operation; trigger = deterministic threshold rule (path flagged anomalous iff divergence score sj>tau, Eq.7-8) -> trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA. S4.1 consensus-based validation compares parallel reasoning paths derived from MULTIPLE memories for logical CONSISTENCY (rule7 FIDELIDAD 'costuras') -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI. S5.1 benchmarks span direct-poisoning (ReAct-StrategyQA/EHRAgent), indirect-injection (MMLU) and multi-agent scalability (MISINFOTASK) -> multiagente=SI. Table1: ASR measured at 3 STAGES (ASR-r retrieval/ASR-a agent-thought/ASR-t end-to-end task) vs No-Defense/LLM-Auditor/Distil-Classifier/PPL baselines: EHRAgent ASR-r 100.0->2.13 (GPT-4o-mini+DPR), consistent >95% reduction while maintaining highest Benign ACC -> the explicit stage-separated ASR-r IS a retrieval-quality measurement -> mide_lectura=SI/RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO. Prior isolated-audit defenses fail because poisoned records look benign OUT OF CONTEXT (ASB: 66% missed) and corrupted outputs become 'self-reinforcing' precedents -> fallos_mitigaciones anchor. evidencia_tipo=ABLATION (Appendix A Sdiv-instantiation ablation, S5.7 top-k sweep) + BENCHMARK-E2E (Table1 4-config x 4-defense comparison). Core mechanism deliberately STORES PAST FAILURES ('detected failures are distilled into lessons... stored separately') as the primary corrective signal -> NEGATIVO(a) per rule7 ('almacena fracasos'), consistent with F_screening. Memory persists across many interactions ('long-term planning', S2) -> alcance=PROYECTO. F differs from F_screening (SEGURIDAD;NEGATIVO) by adding FIDELIDAD, MULTIAGENTE, RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO, CONSOLIDACION per above anchors.
